idioms: gofmt is non-negotiable; match the client's Go version from go.mod.
Return errors, don't panic; wrap with %w and match the client's error-handling style.
Table-driven tests if the client uses them (they usually do).
No new third-party deps for things the stdlib does.
prompt_pack.pr_style: Match existing PR titles in the client repo. Default: package-prefixed summary (e.g. 'server: fix nil deref in handler').
never: Never edit go.sum by hand — go mod tidy only, and only if deps changed.
